name: Ashok Leyland BS6 Bus Mod
shortDescription: Official Shyamoli Ashok Leyland BS6 luxury sleeper bus mod for Bus Simulator Indonesia with realistic engine sounds and smooth driving.
description: Experience the heavy-duty power and comfort of the Ashok Leyland BS6 Shyamoli Luxury Coach in Bus Simulator Indonesia. Features realistic Ashok Leyland H-Series BS6 diesel engine sounds, working air suspension, full 3-button animations (passenger doors, luggage compartment, driver cabin window), custom LED lighting, authentic Shyamoli Paribahan liveries, and high-speed highway stability.
author: VayZenXPlayz
features: Authentic Ashok Leyland BS6 diesel engine sound loops
Full 3-stage interactive animations (Doors & Luggage Compartment)
Detailed sleeper & seater passenger cabin with reading lights
Working dashboard speedometer & illuminated dials
Realistic air brake hiss & reverse warning alarm
High-speed highway gear ratio & smooth air ride
requirements: Bus Simulator Indonesia version 4.0.4 or higher installed
30MB free storage space for mod & livery files

installationGuide.title: Download Mod File
installationGuide.instruction: Click the Download button below to complete Cloudflare verification and unlock your Ashok Leyland BS6 mod file.

installationGuide.title: Move to BUSSID/Mods Directory
installationGuide.instruction: Open ZArchiver or your file manager, locate the downloaded file, and move it to: Internal Storage > BUSSID > Mods.

installationGuide.title: Activate in BUSSID Garage
installationGuide.instruction: Launch Bus Simulator Indonesia, open Garage (Garasi), navigate to the Ashok Leyland BS6 coach and tap 'Use' (Pakai)!
